**[[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]]<ref name="Location">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Aramal [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the grid square J-8 and within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Ryborean sector/Legends|Ryborean sector]]. {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}} depicts that [[Sector/Legends|sector]] as lying in the portion of the Expansion Region between the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress]] and [[Lostar sector/Legends|Lostar sectors]], in the [[trailing]] direction from the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identifies as the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]]. ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' establishes both Mondress and Lostar sectors to be a part of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]], which the [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] further defines as a sub-region located in the northern section of the Expansion Region. Additionally, ''The Essential Atlas'' depicts the square J-8 part of the Expansion Region that lies trailing relative to the Namadii Corridor as being located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]. Therefore, the Aramal system must be a part of both the Outer Expansion Zone and the Northern Dependencies.</ref>

The '''Aramal system''' was located within the [[Ryborean sector/Legends|Ryborean sector]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="EAOC" /> specifically the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion.<ref name="Location" />

A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the Aramal [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Neshtab]] and the [[Ryborea system/Legends|Ryborea system]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the system to the [[Coth Fuuras system/Legends|Coth Fuuras]] and [[Doshan system/Legends|Doshan systems]]. The Aramal system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aramal system was established in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square J-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
